note: Standard prices in US dollars per million tokens for the small models Xenon uses to translate song lyrics. Read by server/lyrics-translate-price.js to show what 100 songs cost; it can only change that displayed figure. Copied from https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing, https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing and https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing on the 'checked' date. When a price changes, update the model AND 'checked' (an older date than the table built into Xenon is ignored). A prefix matches every model id starting with it; the longest wins.
